title: Condition-Aware Selective Abstention on the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering: A Multi-Signal Audit of BBQ Condition Separability
description: Reproducibility artifact for an IEEE Access manuscript that audits condition separability in the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ). The tagged source snapshot contains the frozen-model selective-abstention implementation, corrected experiment outputs, and deterministic stress and transfer audits. The corresponding GitHub release provides the final manuscript PDF, LaTeX source bundle, checksummed replay archive, and SHA-256 manifest. This work was supported by IITP grant IITP-2026-RS-2020-II201741 and NRF grant RS-2026-25468535, both funded by the Korean Government (MSIT).
